subject: res-network-ports-and-listeners
text:
- **Network ports and listeners:** no network port — no TCP or UDP port; one local listener — the driver session's Unix-domain socket `{state_dir}/session.sock`, set to mode `0600` inside a state directory the caller names and `escher_driver::serve` creates `0700`, bound at the tree's one served listener site (beside it, since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, one test-only bind: escher-driver's unix-only unit test `client::imp::tests::an_answer_read_past_its_bound_is_a_timeout` binds a `UnixListener` in `eab-{pid}` under the system temporary directory, accepts one connection and never answers, then removes the directory — no binary serves it and no caller reaches it, so it is no crossing, the operator's answer at that chunk's wrap, 2026-10-15; packages/escher-driver/src/client.rs:263-308), serving three requests at wire version `v3`, a call's replies including the fixed `recording-failed` — `hello`, `stop` and, since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, `call` — so a call's element id and typed text cross in and an answer's ids, accessible names, control values (a password's or a file input's as the fixed mask), snapshot text and diff cross out, no `NodeId` among them, a request line at most 16,384 bytes and an answer at most 1,048,576; still no second listener; unix only — on other targets the lifecycle and a call return `SessionError::Unsupported` in 0.1.0 (packages/escher-driver/src/host.rs:109-124; packages/escher-driver/src/wire.rs:12) — a boundary widening, the founder's choice (the founder, 2026-10-07, relayed verbatim), as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-session/report.md, and widened again from lifecycle messages only to calls and their answers, ratified by the founder (2026-10-10, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label «Сокет несёт команды»;
 the English wording is the overseer's), as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/report.md. Since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface the `escher-session mcp` role (`escher_driver::serve_mcp`) speaks newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over its own stdin and stdout to the MCP client that spawned it, local to the invoking user — no listener, socket or port, so the session socket is still the one listener and there is still no network port; a tool call brings an element id and typed text in, and a result takes ids, accessible names, control values (a password's or a file input's as the fixed mask), snapshot text and diff out — a boundary widening ratified by the founder (2026-10-10, «Ратифицировать как есть», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label; the English wording is the overseer's), as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-mcp-surface/report.md. Since 2026-10-12-self-description the role also serves the `help` tool, answered by the server with no session run, and speaks a fourth handshake revision, `2025-11-25`, now its default; a result also carries the tool's self-description and a session error's remedy, and the tool listing each verb's result fields — the program's own fixed `'static` table text inside the ratified carrier, ratified by the founder (2026-10-12, «Внутри, с правилом», relayed verbatim by the overseer) — and a changed node's `differs`, closed node-key words; still no listener, socket or port, and the session socket unchanged (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-self-description/report.md).
 Since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot both carriers also take a shot of the screen out: the socket's answer to a `screenshot` call holds its PNG as base64 inside the JSON line, and the `mcp` role's result an `image` block (`image/png`, base64) then a text block — screen pixels in band, a boundary widening ratified by the founder (2026-10-12, «В самом ответе», relayed verbatim by the overseer) — still the one listener and no port, the wire's bounds unchanged, an MCP result that holds an image bounded by its whole written form (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md). Both carriers, and a kept check, also take a lint's findings out as the `lint` verb's answer — stable ids, the closed defect words and numbers, no `NodeId`, page text, colour or control value — a ratified boundary widening (§Established Decisions → [Driver session]); still the one listener and no port, the wire's bounds unchanged (as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-19-visual-lint/report-gated.md).
 As adopted, before that chunk, observed absent — network ports or local hosts · searched: `localhost|port` over .github/workflows/*.yml, Cargo.toml, Cross.toml, flake.nix; a listening socket or local port · searched: `TcpListener|localhost|127\.0\.0\.1` over the 32 s03 files; any listening socket or port · searched: `TcpListener|bind\(|listen\(|localhost|127\.0\.0\.1` over the 86 s04 files; network listeners or fixed addresses · searched: `TcpListener|SocketAddr|localhost|127\.0\.0\.1` over the 15 s05 files; network listeners or ports · searched: `TcpListener|localhost|0\.0\.0\.0|\.bind` over the 17 s06 files; ports, sockets or listeners · searched: `port|bind\(|listen` over the 8 s07 files; any network port, socket bind or listener · searched: `fn main|\[\[bin\]\]|clap` over the 16 s08 files; network listeners or fixed host addresses · searched: `TcpListener|UdpSocket|localhost|127\.0\.0\.1` over the 32 s09 files; network listener or port binding · searched: `TcpListener|listen\(` over the 32 s10 files; any network port, host or socket binding · searched: `port|127\.0\.0\.1|localhost` over the 21 s11 files; network ports or listen addresses · searched: `localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|0\.0\.0\.0|bind\(` over the 61 s12 files; a network listener or socket · searched: `TcpListener|TcpStream|bind\(|listen\(` over the 12 s13 files

subject: res-filesystem
res-filesystem
text: - The recording directory: a path the launcher names by `--record <dir>` on `start`, the host role or the `mcp` role (`Session::recording_into` in process) — never an env read or a default, and named by no tool call, verb, argument or result field — created `0700` when absent, its parent existing, and refused `RecordDirNotPrivate` when present and open to its group or others; it holds one `check-{n}.json` per recorded session (`0600`, `create_new`, `n` the smallest from 1 naming no file, so no file is replaced), rewritten whole after every call through `.check-{n}.json.tmp` (`0600`) and a rename; escher removes a check only when its recording ends on a failed write or a passed bound, never a file it did not create and never the directory; unix only (`Unsupported` elsewhere); the state directory still holds `session.sock` alone (packages/escher-driver/src/recording.rs:192-276; packages/escher-driver/src/session.rs:166-190).

subject: res-filesystem
text: - The committed checks: `tests/blitz-tests/checks/counter-cli.json` and `counter-mcp.json`, git mode `100644` in the public repository — the one exception to a kept check's owner-only medium: two kept checks of the repository's own scripted stand-Counter sessions, one through the command line and one through the `mcp` role, holding the Counter's ids, names, values, snapshot text and diffs and the scripts' calls, no typed text, host path, name or secret and no `screenshot` step (a shot's PNG bytes differ by OS, as measured at CI#39225375577); written as the binary records them by `examples/seven_guis/tests/flows/record_checks.sh` (POSIX `sh`, the binary and an existing output directory as its two arguments, its scratch `rec/` made `mkdir -m 700`, printing only `step N` on failure), read by `stand_replay` through `Check::from_bytes`, compared byte for byte with a fresh recording by seven_guis `recording` in `rc-fresh` under `CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR`, uploaded by no CI leg (tests/blitz-tests/checks/counter-cli.json:1-8; tests/blitz-tests/checks/counter-mcp.json:1-11; examples/seven_guis/tests/flows/record_checks.sh:1-65).

text:

text: - **Config management:** documents are configured through the `DocumentConfig` struct (packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:29-72); optional capabilities are compile-time Cargo features, each dioxus-native feature forwarding to the same-named feature of the underlying blitz crates, and `accessibility` also to `dioxus-native-dom/accessibility`, which enables dioxus-native-dom's own optional `accesskit` and gates its `accessibility_tree` override and its `snapshot`, `snapshot_diff`, `snapshot_text` and `actionable` modules (packages/dioxus-native/Cargo.toml:16-33; packages/dioxus-native-dom/Cargo.toml:15-23; packages/dioxus-native-dom/Cargo.toml:41), with feature-gated code in the apps (apps/browser/src/main.rs:23-24; apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:215-258; apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:278-312); launch configs are `Box<dyn Any>` values downcast at launch (packages/dioxus-native/src/lib.rs:115-146); platform behavior is gated with `cfg(target_os = ...)` and an `IS_MOBILE` const (apps/browser/src/main.rs:48; apps/browser/src/main.rs:79-89; apps/browser/src/tab_strip.rs:9-12); on `wasm32` system-font discovery is disabled and `build_single_font_ctx` is the standard WASM setup (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:434-437; packages/blitz-dom/src/lib.rs:134-139); runtime inputs are CLI arguments and environment variables (see Occupied Resources)

subject: crosscut-event-processing
text: - **Event processing:** default-action events are queued and processed in order, each running handlers then its default action unless cancelled (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/driver.rs:352-359; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/driver.rs:423-426); events for sub-documents and custom widgets are forwarded with adjusted coordinates (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:18-27; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:125-180); focused text inputs are re-clamped to keep the caret visible (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:112-123; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:311-318); dioxus skips event kinds with zero handlers (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:326-332; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:349-359); `mounted` listeners fire after `initial_build` and each `poll` (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:331-336; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:144-152; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:216-236); JS microtasks drained after eval, timers and event dispatch (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:1458-1476; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:1639; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:1690-1692); style and layout resolved before JS geometry, hit-test, selection and computed-style reads (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/element.rs:1023-1037; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/document.rs:326-331; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/style.rs:80-84); keyboard shortcuts use Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere (apps/browser/src/tab_strip.rs:42-56; apps/browser/src/util.rs:4-12)

subject: crosscut-invalidation-and-state-integrity
intent
text: - **Front page:** the root `README.md` is escher's own page, not upstream Blitz's — what escher is and, since 2026-10-16-handler-splits-and-readme, its state under `## Status`: 0.1.0 done and verified, its six stages listed with three recorded facts (17 capabilities verified, 43 cold-agent tool calls with 0 wrong, 0 surviving mutants of 1,558), and 0.2.0 planned in five stages, one line per epoch of `escher-0.2.0/working-route.md`, where it read built vs planned; the page spells the name «Escher» in its prose and title, crate, binary and path names, URLs and the e-mail unchanged, on the founder's word «чтоб эшер там с большой буквы писался» (2026-10-16) — and since 2026-10-10-driver-cli how the driver's command line is run (the `escher-session` binary: `start`, one driver command per call answering one line of JSON on stdout, the four exit statuses, `stop`), since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface how an MCP client drives the same apps (it spawns `target/debug/escher-session mcp` as its own child and gets the driver commands as tools, ten since 2026-10-12-self-description and eleven since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot, the page saying eleven since 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship), since 2026-10-12-self-description how to ask for `help` on both surfaces, the screenshot no longer named as still to come since 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship, its Blitz lineage, the 0.1.0 epochs, the licence and an Author / Contact section, with the fork's `ci.yml` badge as its one image (README.md). No build, doc or test step reads it; `rdme` resolves a `README.md` at runtime only (apps/readme/src/main.rs:220-233). At an Upstream sync an upstream change to `README.md` resolves to escher's version (upstream touched it 6 times in the 12 months to 2026-10-06, as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-project-readme/research.md)
